csv_scope_of_work: he Winterset Airport Authority (Sponsor) is hereby soliciting Statement of Qualifications from consultants for airfield development projects that are anticipated to occur within the next five Federal fiscal years 2026 to 2031 at Winterset Municipal Airport (3Y3) located in Winterset, lowa. Subject to receipt of Federal funding and/or State funding, the planning project includes the following: 1. Construct and light Runway 18/36. $8.5 million 2. Construct taxiways to Runway 18/36. $1.6 million 3. Install airfield lights and visual aids 4. 5. 6. Construct and modify airport access roads and parking lots. $1.3 million Construct new building area, including apron. $1.3 million Construct hangars. $1.34 million 7. Construct terminal building. $400,000 8. Reconstruct and construct hangar taxilanes 9. Rehabilitate runway, taxiway and apron pavements These projects have been developed from the Sponsor's Airport Capital Improvement Plan (CIP), which was prepared from the master plan and with some assistance from Olsson. Some project CIP Data Sheets will be available upon request
